rule_1.text: Format the output strictly in lowercase letters with no punctuation. Never capitalize the first letter and never use a period.

rule_2.text: Begin the instruction with a highly frequent action verb, such as "move", "put", "place", "pick up", "take", "remove", "fold", or "unfold".

rule_3.text: Include the definite article "the" before nouns (e.g., write "put the cup on the plate" instead of "put cup on plate").

rule_4.text: Describe objects using basic category nouns (e.g., "pot", "bowl", "block", "cloth"), simple colors (e.g., "blue", "yellow", "red", "green", "orange", "white", "grey", "purple"), and common materials (e.g., "silver", "metal", "plastic", "wooden").

rule_5.text: Specify locations and spatial relations using common prepositions and positional words (e.g., "on", "in", "from", "to", "into", "out of", "left", "right", "top", "bottom", "middle", "corner").

rule_6.text: Do not use politeness markers (e.g., "please"), adverbs of manner (e.g., "carefully"), conditionals (e.g., "if"), exact measurements, or brand names.
